He set the note on his table beside the lamp, found a fresh sheet, and began to write his own reply, ready for the next outgoing tide.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市睡得最沉。街灯还亮着，光晕落在空荡的马路上，没有车，也没有人声。便利店的玻璃窗透出一点暖黄，店员靠在柜台边打盹。远处早班的公交缓缓驶过，轮胎碾过湿漉漉的路面。环卫工推着车慢慢清扫，扫帚声在安静里格外清晰。高楼大多黑着，只有零星几扇窗亮灯，不知是失眠的人，还是刚要起身的人。天边泛起一线极淡的青色，黎明还没来，夜却已经快要退了。", "w03": "• Imagine a set of nesting dolls: to open the biggest one, you keep opening the smaller doll inside, doing the same thing each time.\n• A recursive solution solves a big problem by solving a slightly smaller version of the same problem, over and over.\n• It stops when it reaches the smallest, easiest case that you can answer right away without opening anything else."}
